LightningComponentBundle.description: Displays pending approval items for the current user with inline Approve/Reject actions.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Label shown in the component header.

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: Filter to a specific Salesforce object (e.g. Grid__c). Leave blank for all objects.

property.name: approvalSystem
property.label: Approval System
property.description: 'Custom' for custom approval steps only, 'Standard' for standard Salesforce approvals only. Leave blank for both.

property.name: queues
property.label: Queue Developer Names
property.description: Comma-separated queue developer names. When set, shows all pending approvals for those queues (requires AllowAccessToOthersApprovals permission). Leave blank to show items pending for the current user.
